craft_notes: Sthāyin: vismaya at displayed greatness, settling into praṇaya-śama (C1 rasa block: adbhuta with bhakti). Sanskrit first, my own parse: four feminine instrumentals of means (sugirā/cittahāriṇyā/paśyantyā/dṛśyamānayā) → jayati (3sg victory-cry, mid-verse, NOT verb-final) → ullāsitānandamahimā parameśvaraḥ (subject lands last). Firing rows: compounds (cittahāriṇyā, ullāsitānandamahimā) held whole in line 1 — enjambed unpacking REFUSED, the pile-up is the meaning (row 2); verb-mid + subject-last → end-weight subject, triumph struck mid-line (row 1 adapted: suspense from held breath of means, double release: cry, then crown); vowel arc bright (steal/watch) → broad (triumphs/power/joy) → dark (God on high) (row 8, free); śānta-close falling cadence on end-weighted subject (row 12); image left standing — honeyed lips, mind-stealing, watcher/watched kept exact, Vṛtti Vāk-doctrine (paśyantī/madhyamā/vaikharī, sphuṭam unmagnarūpatvena sphurantī) noted, never imported (row 10); deixis already general, kept bare (row 11). Rupture (camatkāra-point): em-dash after the full means-catalogue — pattern set, then break, then triumph. Close: colon landing on 'God on high' (śānta-fall). Minimal pass: 2 punctuation moves (comma→dash end line 1; end-dash→colon), zero diction changes. Read aloud: line 1 runs the catalogue on one breath held by the dash; line 2 strikes (TRIumphs) then falls (GOD on HIGH); it scans.
